about: The document check on the study's real case: a post characterising a law firm's six-page letter, shown as four images (two of them two-page spreads). Run 2026-10-25 in Node with Daylight's own recogniser, each image scaled to at most 2,400 pixels a side as the extension does. Only terms and counts are kept; the letter's text and the images stay outside the repository.
note: The single word "classified" appears once, on image 3, in another sense ("would certainly not be classified as a defender"); the post's phrase "classified information" does not appear.
